第11章 南山宗化婴丹（第1页）
听到这话，张云和灵仙宗众长老都是面露诧异。
南山宗跟灵仙宗一样，是南云州一方实力能排入前五的修仙宗门。并且跟灵仙宗很近，两宗相邻不足千里，都位于南云州的南部区域。
但两宗的关系可不怎么好，甚至可以说是敌对。
毕竟一山不容二虎，作为南云州南部区域两方最强宗门，时常会因为南部的一些利益资源而产生摩擦。日积月累下来，这关系不说水火不容，也是一言不合就可能立马干架的那种。
此刻南山宗的宗主，竟然出现在他们灵仙宗内？
对方到来，灵仙宗宗主肯定知晓。此刻将他们叫来，难道也与此人有关？
“今日将你们叫来，是有一件我宗跟南山宗的事要宣布！”
灵仙宗宗主开口，“在你们来之前，本座已与南山宗主达成了协议，准备举行一场两宗交流会！”
旁边南山宗宗主接话，道：“这场交流会的内容，将以诸位长老和我宗诸位长老之间的比拼展开！”
南山宗宗主摇头，笑道：“本宗在南山宗上任不久，促成这场交流会，是希望我们两宗之间能缓和缓和关系。因此不想诸位长老拼出火气。这场交流会的内容，主要为两宗长老带徒弟的历练比拼为主！”
“两宗每位长老都可以带两位炼气期弟子参与……”
南山宗宗主解释道：“在交流会开始后，会发布一些历练任务，完成任务会获得相应积分。同时通过猎杀灵兽等方式，也能获得积分。在规定时间内，根据每位长老得到的积分进行排名。”
顿了顿，他忽然取出了一个精致的木盒：“为了激励诸位长老，此次交流会排名前列者都会得到奖励。排名第一者，更是将得到此物！”
一股浓郁的药香顿时在大殿内四溢而开。
特别是已经达到金丹期巅峰的灵仙宗大长老，只感觉瓶颈都因此微微松动。
这让他死死盯着木盒内，有些激动问道：“化婴丹？这是化婴丹吗？？”
化婴丹，顾名思义，这是能够帮助金丹期巅峰修士凝聚元婴的一种高等级丹药。放在市面上，一颗至少要过十万灵石，并且有价无市。

南山宗宗主点头，道：“谁在交流会获得第一名，此丹就归谁！”
虽然除了大长老外，其他人还不是金丹期巅峰。但现在不能用，不代表未来不能用。毕竟能踏入金丹期的，未来迈入金丹期巅峰只是时间问题。

Chapter 11 Nanshan Zong Huaying Dan (Page 1)
Hearing this, Zhang Yun and the elders of Lingxian Sect looked surprised.
Nanshan Sect, like Lingxian Sect, is one of the top five immortal cultivating sects in Nanyun Prefecture. And it is very close to the Lingxian Sect. The two sects are less than a thousand miles apart and are both located in the southern area of ​​Nanyun Prefecture.
But the relationship between the two sects is not very good, and can even be said to be hostile.
After all, there is no room for two tigers in one mountain. As the two strongest sects in the southern region of Nanyun Prefecture, frictions often arise due to some interests and resources in the south. Over time, this relationship has become not only incompatible, but also the kind that could lead to an immediate fight if they disagree.
At this moment, the master of Nanshan Sect actually appeared in their Lingxian Sect?
The leader of the Lingxian Sect will definitely know when the other party is coming. Could it be that calling them here now has something to do with this person?
"I called you here today because I have something to announce about our sect and the Nanshan sect!"
The leader of the Lingxian Sect said, "Before you come, I have reached an agreement with the leader of the Nanshan Sect and are preparing to hold an exchange meeting between the two sects!"
The leader of the Nanshan Sect next to him answered the conversation and said: "The content of this exchange meeting will be a competition between the elders and the elders of our sect!"
The head of the Nanshan Sect shook his head and said with a smile: "Not long after I took office in the Nanshan Sect, I organized this exchange meeting in the hope that the relationship between our two sects can be eased and eased. Therefore, I don't want you elders to get angry. The content of this exchange meeting is mainly about the experience competition between the elders of the two sects and their apprentices!"
"Each elder of the two sects can bring two disciples in the Qi refining stage to participate..."
The leader of the Nanshan Sect explained: "After the exchange meeting begins, some training tasks will be released, and corresponding points will be obtained for completing the tasks. At the same time, points can also be obtained by hunting spiritual beasts. Within the specified time, each elder will be ranked according to the points obtained."
After a pause, he suddenly took out an exquisite wooden box: "In order to motivate the elders, those who rank at the top of this exchange meeting will receive rewards. The one who ranks first will get this thing!"
A strong medicinal fragrance suddenly overflowed in the hall.
Especially the great elder of the Lingxian Sect, who had reached the peak of the Golden Core stage, felt that the bottleneck was slightly loosened by this.
This made him stare at the wooden box and asked with some excitement: "Huaying Dan? Is this the Baby Hua Dan?"
The Infant Transformation Pill, as the name suggests, is a high-level elixir that can help peak cultivators in the Golden Elixir stage condense their Nascent Soul. On the market, one would cost at least 100,000 spiritual stones, and it was priceless but not marketable.
The head of the Nanshan Sect nodded and said: "Whoever wins first place in the exchange meeting will get this elixir!"
Although except for the great elder, others are not at the peak of the golden elixir stage. But just because it can’t be used now, doesn’t mean it won’t be used in the future. After all, for those who can enter the Golden Core stage, it is only a matter of time before they reach the peak of the Golden Core stage in the future.
